propositions: Passing prior-attempt search frontier as an exclusion-list data block inside the verifier's untrusted fence does not reduce re-search overlap; on both test tickets, treatment arm showed equal or higher overlap rate than control (45c1: +78% relative, 8d74: +60% relative), failing the predeclared 30% reduction threshold.

The untrusted fence renders data-shaped evidence blocks inert by design; the model ignored listed searched-and-empty paths and immediately re-executed identical searches, and in some cases treated the frontier block as a signpost that guided it back to the same files, raising measured overlap rather than reducing it.

Verifier telemetry currently lacks argument-level tool-call transcripts (paths, patterns, result classifications) needed to detect re-search overlap; the PoC captured these harness-side only, exposing a production gap if this mechanism were ever productized.

Cache-seeding via the verdict cache (the locust behavior) already eliminates the dominant redundancy—re-proving credited criteria; the residual re-grounding of unproven criteria cannot be suppressed by an exclusion list inside an untrusted fence without violating evidence integrity semantics.
